mapper.insert: INSERT INTO train_server_gpu_snapshot (server_id, account_id, gpu_uuid, visible_index, total_memory_mib, used_memory_mib, utilization_percent, mig_mode, driver_version, compute_processes, sampled_at, created_at) VALUES (#{serverId}, #{accountId}, #{gpuUuid}, #{visibleIndex}, #{totalMemoryMiB}, #{usedMemoryMiB}, #{utilizationPercent}, #{migMode}, #{driverVersion}, CAST(#{computeProcessesJson} AS JSON), #{sampledAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT snapshot_id, server_id, account_id, gpu_uuid, visible_index, total_memory_mib, used_memory_mib, utilization_percent, mig_mode, driver_version, CAST(compute_processes AS CHAR) AS compute_processes_json, sampled_at, created_at FROM train_server_gpu_snapshot WHERE server_id = #{serverId} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND gpu_uuid = #{gpuUuid} ORDER BY sampled_at DESC, snapshot_id DESC LIMIT 1
